purpose: Run a controlled local canary where LangGraph is treated as the default backend only inside an isolated shell/session by setting AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph
isolation_rules: Set AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph only inside that shell.
Do not persist AGENT_V2_BACKEND at Machine or User level.
Do not change startup scripts permanently.
All probes must be read-only or smoke-test only.
After canary, unset AGENT_V2_BACKEND and verify Native.
safety_statement: This canary simulates local default behavior by environment override only. It does not modify code default.
canary_scope: smoke test execution under LangGraph opt-in
explicitly_forbidden: touching trading, IBKR, broker, strategy, portfolio, or risk files
touching autonomous journal or promotion queues
